newsitem.title: romania: Romanian leu ends flat vs dlr, money market slips.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends flat vs dlr, money market slips.

text.p: 1345 GMT - The Romanian leu closed Tuesday unchanged at 3,240/50 to the dollar on a steady, quiet interbank market.
* Operators said trading kept a subdued tone with few dollar owners ready to join the market. Some volumes emerged in other currencies, in which quotes deliver at cross weaker leu-dollar prices.
* Latest central bank data show interbank turnover of $222,800 on Monday. Overall trading was $11.4 million.
* Short-term rates fell to about 46 percent from some 51 percent on a money market flooded with leu funds. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
